summary: ManageMeals is a self-hosted recipe management tool designed to extract recipes from URLs and store them locally. It provides a clean interface for organising culinary instructions without advertisements or extraneous blog text.
goodFor: It suits home cooks who want a dedicated, ad-free repository for digital recipes extracted from various websites.
watchOut: The low maintenance health score indicates that you may encounter unpatched bugs or slow responses to pull requests.
deployNotes: You can deploy it using Docker, which typically requires persistent storage volumes to retain your recipe database across container restarts.
